notes.title: Version 1.03 is out now！Easy Mode is available.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thanks so much for your support and attention!

Cruel Bands Career is designed to be a challenging game. However, we do hope more players can enjoy it. So here is a piece of good news for you: In this update, we put an easy mode in the game, and at the same time there is also a separate “Best Record” for it. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35671302/0cc64d73f4e3412ae34e3f2816b71f7acd464a24.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35671302/747ecbcaea2fbf6f6abb3aa3d86a81e6fb564e7c.png

By the way, Cruel Bands Career has a true ending. You can find it in both normal and easy modes, with some requirements. Welcome to challenge.

We sincerely hope that you will enjoy this game. If you have any problems or suggestions about this game, feel free to contact with us. Thank you.

notes.title: Version 1.02 is out now, with the Original SoundTrack available!
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone,

Thanks so much for your support and attention! We all know Cruel Bands Career is a very unusual title and we've received a huge amount of feedback. The good news is that we've got the first update ready for all of you, here's the list:

- Many players have mentioned that this game is somehow too difficult. We've added a hidden easy mode with 10 lives, please choose it as you want. However, what you need to know is that, in this mode, the best records for the most coins and the fastest run won't be updated in film01.

Here's the tip how to enter this hidden easy mode, very similar to the classical Konami code:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35671302/d31c93dc84356b2d78905765b8f01dce69dab704.png

- Fixed a problem with some users in Sydney or New Zealand system timezones stuck in the loading screen.
- Fixed a few other bugs.

By the way, the Official Soundtrack of Cruel Bands Career is ready too, which includes If you didn't own it yet, you can always get it from the bundle with an additional 10% off discount.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389220/Cruel_Bands_Career__Official_Soundtrack/

Hope you can enjoy our game, and feel free to let us know if you have any good suggestions.
